task_requests.description: Perform Value at Risk (VaR) analysis and reporting.
Conduct stress testing and scenario analysis for risk assessment.

args.data: This workspace includes two workstreams: the Value at Risk (VaR) analysis led by the var-analyst, and the stress testing and scenario analysis led by the stress-analyst. Both workstreams are equipped with the VaR Trend widget to monitor risk exposure trends effectively.
args.name: Coordinator Note on Workstreams
